basis: THIS PILOT ONLY. Detroit's Firecrawl rates were measured on IHG, Choice and Wyndham through a different provider and are not carried here in any form.

measured_cost.caveat: the zone meter is month-to-date and settles upward; this is a floor at the time it was read

MARRIOTT.spend_basis: the measured $0.165 per attempt from this pilot, not a vendor list price

HILTON.spend_basis: the measured $0.165 per attempt from this pilot, not a vendor list price

OTHER_DEFERRED.why_not_sized: these are the registry-deferred families, not Marriott or Hilton. This pilot measured two brand walls and says nothing about them; sizing them from it would be the same extrapolation this order forbids in the other direction.

sizing_rule: Wilson LOWER bound, never the point estimate
